runs.text: In Jordan, thirty nine percent of young people who want a job cannot find one. This is youth unemployment, ages fifteen to twenty four, since two thousand. Lowest first. In two thousand, Israel was at seventeen percent. Almost double America. Saudi Arabia hits almost thirty percent in twenty twenty. Then it cuts that by more than half. Turkey peaks at twenty five percent in twenty nineteen, then comes down to sixteen. Syria and Jordan stay stuck above thirty. France ends near nineteen. Britain, fourteen. At the top, a photo finish. Germany, the UAE, Israel. Fair point: many young Israelis are in the army, not on the job market. What helps young people find work? Tell me in the comments. So who has the lowest of all twelve? Israel. Six point two percent.
